rationale: The most recent 5-minute candle shows clear exhaustion mechanics: price opened at $8.88, failed to exceed the session high of $8.95, and closed lower at $8.81 on sharply reduced volume (379K vs. 1.18M prior candle), indicating buying pressure is drying up near the highs. Over 27.7M shares have traded against a float of only 25.9M — more than 100% of float has turned over — suggesting the immediate demand pool is largely exhausted. A short targeting the 5-minute VWAP at $7.95 offers roughly 4.5:1 reward-to-risk against a stop just above today's high, a level whose breach would invalidate the exhaustion thesis.
